nodes.label: ARCH-001
nodes.requirement: Keep cloud-provider core provider-neutral; provider-specific behavior stays in drivers.

nodes.label: ACC-001
nodes.requirement: Accounts retain independent provider, proxy, identity and lifecycle state.

nodes.label: NET-001
nodes.requirement: Required account proxy egress is isolated and fail-closed.

nodes.label: LIFE-001
nodes.requirement: Server/deployment work is a reconciled observable state machine with one coherent execution owner.

nodes.label: DO-001
nodes.requirement: DigitalOcean behavior remains functional while generic/provider-neutral architecture evolves.

nodes.label: VULTR-001
nodes.requirement: Vultr uses provider-specific read/mutation/catalog/capacity semantics behind common provider contracts.

nodes.label: VULTR-002
nodes.requirement: Determine Vultr capacity accurately; browser-only interactive capacity observation stays isolated from generic provider core.

nodes.label: VULTR-003
nodes.requirement: Cloudflare/CAPTCHA/2FA is solved manually through an interactive console/noVNC session; authorized state may then be reused.

nodes.label: PANEL-001
nodes.requirement: Sanaei/x-ui is a modular panel integration; live reads/writes use Sanaei API where implemented.

nodes.label: OUT-001
nodes.requirement: Output is fast/live and does not use SSH scraping as its live data plane.

nodes.label: OUT-002
nodes.requirement: Direct Output and share links apply canonical exact visibility/expiry semantics so invalid configs disappear on time.

nodes.label: REAL-001
nodes.requirement: Reality/VLESS ports, SNI, target users, quota, lifetime and device limit remain policy-driven.

nodes.label: RES-001
nodes.requirement: Residential routing is separate from account/provider control-plane proxy assignment.

nodes.label: UI-001
nodes.requirement: Admin modules remain operational/mobile-friendly and preserve working context; interactive challenges provide visible browser feedback.

nodes.label: OPS-001
nodes.requirement: Never infer production revision from service health alone; verify Git/build/runtime/artifact hashes.

nodes.label: KNOW-001
nodes.requirement: Fresh sessions recover intent, architecture, source lines, semantic relationships, schema, tests and runtime from commit-pinned project knowledge.
